# ci-diagnose (custom agent)

Fullsend custom agent (`ci-diagnose`) that diagnoses failing **Konflux** CI
checks on GitHub pull requests, classifies flaky vs real failures, and supports
bounded flake retries.

Implements the MVP for [KONFLUX-14506](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/KONFLUX-14506).

**Forge:** GitHub · **Inference:** Vertex AI

## Status

| Component | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| Harness, prompt, schema, policy (GitHub + Vertex) | Scaffolded |
| Pre/post scripts | Placeholders (not implemented) |
| Classification skill | Minimal scaffold |
| Konflux debug skill integration | Pending |
| Pilot registration / smoke test | Pending |

## Agent contract

The agent writes JSON validated by
[`schemas/ci-diagnose-result.schema.json`](schemas/ci-diagnose-result.schema.json):

- `status`: `diagnosed` | `needs_human` | `error`
- `classification`: `flaky` | `infra` | `code` | `unknown`
- `confidence`: `0.0`–`1.0`
- `recommended_action`: `retry` | `comment_only` | `escalate`
- `failures[]`, `retry_targets[]`, `pr_comment_markdown`, `reasoning`

Retry is allowed only when `classification` is `flaky` and confidence meets
`MIN_RETRY_CONFIDENCE` (default `0.7`), within `MAX_FLAKE_RETRIES` (default `1`).

## Security model

Per Fullsend conventions:

- The sandboxed agent **does not** post PR comments or re-run checks
- The **pre-script** gathers check context on the trusted runner
- The **post-script** performs side effects using runner credentials
- Vertex AI credentials are injected via `host_files` for inference only

## Registration

After pre/post scripts are implemented, register from the repo root:

```bash
fullsend agent add .fullsend/customized/harness/ci-diagnose.yaml \
  --name ci-diagnose
```

Or pin a remote harness URL with an integrity hash (see
[ADR 0058](https://github.com/fullsend-ai/fullsend/blob/main/docs/ADRs/0058-agent-registration.md)
and [Bring Your Own Agent](https://github.com/fullsend-ai/fullsend/blob/main/docs/guides/user/bring-your-own-agent.md)).

Suggested identity:

- Role: `ci-diagnose`
- Slug: `konflux-ci-diagnose`

## Local dry-run (later)

```bash
export REPO_FULL_NAME=owner/repo
export PR_NUMBER=123
export HEAD_SHA=<sha>
export GH_TOKEN=<token>
fullsend run ci-diagnose
```

## Out of scope (MVP)

- GitLab pipelines
- Auto-filing GitHub/Jira failure issues
- Auto code-fix PRs
- Cluster-wide `kubectl` without an approved read-only credential path
